title: Midterms Signal Looming Data Center Bans in Western States

meta.summary:
The data center industry can expect to see the pace of development slow dramatically, as several Western states are expected to consider statewide moratoriums after the midterm elections that saw Democrats win numerous governor’s races. 
 The post  Midterms Signal Looming Data Center Bans in Western States  appeared first on  RTO Insider .

title: Data Centers Lose Big in Local Referenda

meta.summary:
Of the 47 data center ballot measures in cities, towns and counties, 38 were approved by voters, according to a tracker. Votes are still being counted on six, while one was rejected by voters in the city of Harwood, N.D. 
 The post  Data Centers Lose Big in Local Referenda  appeared first on  RTO Insider .

title: Virtual power plants can help avoid overbuilt grid if AI boom goes bust

meta.summary: Nobody really knows how much power the data center boom will need — and that’s putting utilities in a tough spot. If they underinvest in power plants and the grid, economic growth and energy reliability will suffer. But if they overinvest, Americans may pay for infrastructure nobody needs.
